title: AI AD DESIGNER - 30s Instagram Reel Intro

shots.name: THE UNSTOPPABLE HOOK
shots.visual: Black frame. At 0.15s a razor-thin white light slices the screen; 3D black-titanium word IGNORED? punches toward lens and fractures into suspended fragments; freeze on impact; fragments become reflective product surfaces.
shots.camera: Aggressive push-in, lens distortion, directional motion blur, single white flash.
shots.sound: Metallic snap, sub-bass impact, explosive transient, short reverse riser, near-silence.

shots.name: PREMIUM PRODUCT REVEAL
shots.visual: Futuristic smartphone floating in black architectural space; narrow light beam travels over glass and metal.
shots.camera: Rapid orbit, dive to polished edge, speed ramp, shallow DOF, volumetric haze, subtle chromatic separation.
shots.sound: Smooth whoosh, glass beam shimmer, low pulse.
shots.transition_out: Phone rotates to lens; camera module becomes a portal.

shots.name: LUXURY PRODUCT ADVERTISING
shots.visual: Luxury fragrance bottle on reflective black surface, droplets, mist, metallic ribbons, champagne caustics; slow-motion droplet impact creates a liquid-metal ripple.
shots.sound: Glass chime, liquid impact, reversed metallic swell, deep pulse.
shots.transition_out: Ripple dissolves into reflective particles and mist.

shots.name: FUTURISTIC BEAUTY & COSMETIC AD
shots.visual: Metallic skincare container emerges from luminous mist; liquid-chrome ribbons spiral into a halo and become translucent liquid sheets; pearl-white and champagne highlights.
shots.camera: Single continuous move through the ribbons.
shots.sound: Soft liquid swells, airy texture, subtle pulse.
shots.transition_out: A droplet expands until its reflection fills the frame.

shots.name: HIGH-ENERGY BEVERAGE COMMERCIAL
shots.visual: Unbranded premium metallic can bursts in among icy particles and splashes; condensation beads; circular liquid arc; ice fragments at multiple depths.
shots.camera: Fast 270-degree orbit against slow-motion can rotation; speed ramps; match cuts.
shots.sound: Liquid splash, ice crack, punchy whoosh, metallic impact, rhythmic percussion.
shots.transition_out: Circular liquid wave becomes a luminous UI ring.

shots.name: SAAS, APP & DIGITAL PRODUCT ADVERTISING
shots.visual: Floating glass panels, clean app screens, modular UI cards, restrained dashboard charts; a rising graph becomes a pathway.
shots.camera: Fly-through between interface layers with parallax.
shots.sound: Digital ticks, interface clicks, soft synth pulses, rising tonal layer.
shots.transition_out: The graph pathway leads the camera forward.

shots.name: ADVANCED MOTION GRAPHICS SHOWCASE
shots.visual: Massive procedural environment: thousands of lines forming a 3D wave, coordinated geometry, expanding rings, particle splines; black-and-white minimalism with electric-blue accents.
shots.transition_out: Geometry converges into a single luminous point.

shots.name: THE TRANSFORMATION MOMENT
shots.visual: Luminous point expands into a portal of miniature ad worlds (phone, fragrance, cosmetic, beverage, interface); at 22.0s fragments converge into a clean premium composition.
shots.camera: Single continuous motion-control path with selective speed ramps.

shots.name: THE GROWTH MESSAGE
shots.visual: Abstract glass structure; luminous line rises from the bottom generating geometric forms and expanding rings; gold-white highlights. No financial symbols, numbers, or statistics.
shots.sound: Rising orchestral-electronic layer, layered impacts, controlled climax.

shots.name: CREATOR IDENTITY REVEAL
shots.visual: Clean black; thin silver line sweeps across and becomes the baseline for the title. Subtle dimensional depth only.
shots.sound: Most memorable musical moment resolving into a deep polished impact.

shots.name: CLIENT-FOCUSED CTA
shots.visual: Black background, subtle silver light sweep, faint reflective floor, drifting particles. Final frame: AI AD DESIGNER + CTA only.
shots.sound: Clean resolution with a short polished tail.
